topic: The 5-minute daily habit your heart will thank you for

scenes.line: Five minutes. That's all your heart is asking for.
scenes.visual: Dr. Ira, chest-up, holds up five fingers, warm smile
scenes.animation: Big '5:00' timer pops in beside her, scale 0.6 to 1, back.out

scenes.line: A brisk five-minute walk after meals gets your heart pumping and helps your body handle blood sugar.
scenes.visual: Walking-figure icon on a path, heart icon pulsing
scenes.animation: Path draws left to right, heart pulses on each beat

scenes.line: Adults need about 150 minutes of moderate activity a week.
Short walks count, and they add up fast.
scenes.visual: Seven small 5-min blocks stacking into a bar
scenes.animation: Blocks drop in one per word, stagger 0.12 s

scenes.line: Brisk means you can talk, but not sing.
scenes.visual: Dr. Ira nods, speech bubble with tick, music note with cross
scenes.animation: Bubble and note pop in on 'talk' and 'sing'

scenes.line: Start with one walk a day, then build from there.
Save this, and take your first five-minute walk today.
scenes.visual: Dr. Ira points to save icon, friendly wave
Cream card with Pulse Health logo
